dish: Stuffed French toast, baked oatmeal and giant cinnamon rolls from the scratch bakery
w: Tiny scratch kitchen on Chocolate Avenue voted Central Pennsylvania's best breakfast by Harrisburg Magazine readers for some two decades running; no reservations, so lines form early.

dish: Sundaes and hand-dipped ice cream at Mount Gretna's 1895 parlor
w: Mount Gretna's seasonal ice-cream parlor, a Chautauqua tradition since 1895; its spring opening day is local news.
